introduction: Oregon WIC enrollment takes place through a local clinic. The online interest form helps connect you to services and is not a completed benefit application.
description: Oregon WIC enrollment takes place through a local clinic. The online interest form helps connect you to services and is not a completed benefit application.

sections.who: WIC assesses the pregnancy or young-child category, nutrition needs and income. Qualifying OHP, TANF, SNAP or FDPIR participation can establish income eligibility.
sections.get: The program provides approved foods, breastfeeding help and nutrition support.
sections.docs:
• Applicant identification.
  • Residence and income or qualifying benefit information requested by the clinic.
  • Child and health records the clinic asks you to bring.
sections.apply:
1. Find a clinic

    Use the state clinic link or interest form.

  2. Speak with clinic staff

    Arrange the actual eligibility appointment and ask for a document checklist.

  3. Complete enrollment

    Discuss nutrition needs and learn how the approved food package is used.
sections.after: Keep follow-up appointments and ask clinic staff about shopping questions or breastfeeding support.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Local clinic enrollment and services, Income eligibility. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Does the interest form apply for benefits?
The state expressly says it is not an official application; you must speak with a clinic.
Yes. Oregon lists qualifying SNAP and other benefit participation for that purpose.
Where can I find approved foods?
The state WIC page links its current food list and shopping guidance.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
